question: Which Indian sprinter bagged two gold medals, one each in the men's 100 and 200- metre races at the Flanders Cup 2023 athletics meet?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amlan Borgohain**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amlan Borgohain** is an Indian sprinter who recently made headlines by winning two gold medals at the Flanders Cup 2023 athletics meet.
 
• He secured the gold in both the men’s 100-metre and 200-metre races.
 
• The Flanders Cup is a prestigious athletics meet that attracts top athletes from around the world.
 
• Amlan’s performance at this event adds to his growing reputation as one of India’s leading sprinters.

• **Amlan Borgohain** has been consistently performing well in national and international events, contributing to the rise of Indian athletics on the global stage.

• His achievements are a source of inspiration for budding athletes in India, encouraging them to pursue excellence in sports.
 
• India’s athletics community has been celebrating Amlan’s success, recognizing the hard work and dedication that goes into such high-level performances.
